requirements_summary: Workload: real-time RAG for tiered support agent + public KB ticket deflection
Indexing scale: target 10M-25M documents (mix of short FAQs, long KB articles, attachments), incremental daily delta ~50k docs
Latency SLOs: top-5 end-to-end (embedding search + candidate fetch + rerank) p95 <= 120ms; p99 < 250ms for agent queries
Throughput: baseline 200 qps for support UI bursts, peak 1200 qps during incident
Cost sensitivity: target cost per query <= $0.002 (amortized across embeddings + retriever + re-ranker), CFO conservative
Reranking quality: human-eval top-5 precision target 0.78+ on representative test set
Model preferences: open quantized models allowed for reranker + encoder; prefer 8-bit/4-bit quantization and latency-optimized kernels
Fallbacks: require automated fallback to smaller models or cached answers under high load
Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS-integrated key management, per-tenant audit logs, EU data residency for EU customers
Operational: request per-route latency/cost dashboards, alerting on drift in rerank quality
notes: Sales notes: very pragmatic buyers — product leads came from Zendesk/Intercom world; care about measurable ticket deflection
SE notes: currently prototyping with in-house vector store (open source) + custom ANN; worried about 95th percentile tail under 25M index

POC constraints: use masked test set of 50k queries derived from top support categories; will run blind eval for rerank quality
Evaluation criteria: latency (p95/p99), cost per Q, top-5 precision, reproducible rollout steps, security attestations
